briefs.name: Book Club Lunch
briefs.notes: Book club lunch. Guests order from a menu on their phones and every burger is cooked to order, built exactly as that guest ordered it — there is no self-serve topping bar. Guests pick single or double patties and can come back for seconds; the host will make sure there's enough, so plan generously rather than one burger each. Chopping and prep can be done the day before, but all cooking happens the day of — everything should be fresh. The menu is exactly these dishes and hearty on purpose — do not add a salad, vegetable side or anything else. Equipment: oven, stovetop, microwave, rice cooker, blender and waffle iron are all free; the air fryer, Tovala, griddle and slow cooker can only run one at a time. The stovetop is the crunch point: fry the onion rings first and hold them crisp in the oven with the fries, so the burners are free for burgers and eggs. Caramelize the onions early and just rewarm them.

dishes.notes: Cooked to order, one ticket at a time, built exactly as the guest ordered. Smash-burger technique — hard press on a hot surface for a crust — but a thicker patty than a true smash burger, which is too thin. Cooked through, no pink. Cook in skillets on the stovetop, not on the griddle. Guests choose single or double patty. Cheese: Gruyère and/or American, or none — melted onto the patty; extra cheese is an option, so have plenty of both. Toasted potato buns (toast in a skillet). Toppings guests can choose (none, regular or extra): caramelized chopped onion, pickles, tomato, lettuce. Fried egg optional — runny or hard, guest's choice, cooked to order. Sauces guests can choose: the special sauce (see the Special sauce dish) plus bottled ketchup, mayo and mustard.
Baked in the oven on sheet pans — not fried in oil and not in the air fryer. Enough for seconds for 8.
Fried in oil. Fry them first, before the burgers, and hold them crisp in the oven with the fries so the burners are free for burgers and eggs.

In-N-Out-style special sauce — tangy, a little sweet, with pickle. Absolutely no mayo in any form: no mayonnaise, aioli, Miracle Whip or mayo-based dressing. Base is full-fat sour cream. One sauce does double duty: on the burgers and as the dipping sauce for fries and onion rings, so make enough for both. Ketchup, mayo and mustard are offered to guests straight from the bottle — don't make them, and the bottled mayo is for guests only; it never goes into this sauce.
Two flavors for guests to choose from: vanilla and Oreo. Made in the blender.
